description: Dates of the reference sample. All on relative orbit R094, the orbit whose swath covers the four tiles of the domain. snowline_m is the elevation of the lower snow limit read by eye by the labeller on a 60 m L1C true-colour overview of the domain with 500 m GLO-30 contours, before any point was drawn; it only places the snowline sampling band (snowline_m +- 200 m). null: no continuous snow cover to place a band on.

dates.note: Before the first snowfall; fair-weather cumulus over the south slopes and the eastern ridge.
First lasting snow on the high western massif; bare ground below about 2,400 m.
Fresh snow after a storm, cloud remnants over the eastern half.
Lowest snow of the sample after an early-January storm; thin cloud veil over the north-west.
Clear mid-winter scene, low sun (29 degrees), long shadows on north faces.
Snow down to about 1,800 m in the north-west after a February storm; convective cloud over the south slopes.
Late-winter cover with scattered cumulus over snow and bare ground.
Clear scene at the start of the melt; patchy snow on the eastern ridge.
Melt after an April snowfall; continuous cover only on the western massif.
Melting, dust-tinted snow with cumulus over it: the hardest snow and cloud separation of the sample.
Patchy snow above about 2,600 m; cumulus over the west and the eastern ridge.
Clear scene, snow patches on the summits and north faces only.
Last snow patches around the summits; a thin smoke or cloud plume over the central south slopes.
Crest Veleta to Mulhacen bare except the ski resort; haze and thin cloud over much of the domain.
